title: States sue to stop Paramount-Warner Bros blockbuster merger
summary: California is among the states suing to block Paramount from buying Warner Bros. Discovery in a Hollywood mega-merger that would unite some of the nation's largest movie studios and TV newsrooms.
contentText:
